## Activity

During January 2025, Market Eye Clinic completed 410 captures. Activity was delivered in line with the expected operational schedule. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the month. No further operational exception is recorded in the available information.

## Image quality

There were 99 ungradable image sets, giving an ungradable rate of 24.1 per cent. This result should be considered alongside the total capture volume for January 2025. The ungradable images represent the proportion of completed captures that could not be used for grading. Monitoring this measure remains important for identifying any requirement for operational review and supporting consistent image capture at Market Eye Clinic.

## Grading

A total of 75 results were graded referable during the reporting period. The median grading lag was 9 days. This records the typical interval for grading activity and provides a measure of turnaround for the month. The referable results and grading lag should be reviewed with the activity and image-quality measures to support ongoing oversight of service performance at Market Eye Clinic.
